targets.baseline_commit_message: collect-and-rank-viewer-questions: the old question_library script, byte copy (first commit of a port)

preserve: a comment is kept when it is top-level, its whitespace-folded length is within min_chars..max_chars, and it matches is_question or is_situation (ignoring case)
kind is question when is_question matches, else situation
each tag column lists, in order, every tag whose regex matches, ignoring case
rows sorted by likes, most first, ties in source then comment order; the evidence is real viewer comment
by-concept.md: the count line, then for each tag of the grouped column its count and its most-liked 12
allowed_deltas: the keep rules and tag columns are the person's settings row (keep_comments, comment_tags, comment_group_by, comment_group_top), read through tools/settings, not a buckets file
the tag columns are named by the settings instead of two fixed columns
the header is written when no comment is kept (the old script failed on an empty run); the out folder is made
the count goes to standard error and the last line is {result}, or {error} with exit 2
banned_substitutions: a second copy of this job in another folder
a person's bucket, concept, framework, path or name written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of source-repo-a beside this one finds it.
